key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Upright shrub, often in wetter riparian or seep habitats.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Alternate, linear-lanceolate to narrowly elliptic, usually longer than in B. neglecta.

key_traits.label: Heads
key_traits.text: Small discoid heads in clusters; female plants conspicuous in fruit.
